title: 第1845章 暗影令中始祖现玄帝吞天破困局第1844章 暗影殿中藏杀机玄帝只手镇星河
content_zh:
黑色光柱直冲云霄，将整片星空都染成了墨色。
那股苏醒的气息，越来越强。
仿佛一头沉睡的远古凶兽，正在从深渊中爬出。
星空中那些闪烁的星辰，被那股气息震慑，纷纷黯淡下去，连光线都在那股气息面前变得扭曲。
林玄站在那颗崩碎了一半的星辰残骸上，抬头看着那道黑色光柱，目光平静。
他能感觉到，那股气息确实超越了混洞境。
那是混洞境之上的力量——道衍境的力量。
暗影幽看着林玄，发出一声狞笑：“林玄，你看到了吗？这，就是暗影殿始祖的力量！你一个刚刚突破混洞境的小辈，在始祖面前，不过是蝼蚁！”
林玄没有看他，目光依然落在那道黑色光柱上。
他缓缓开口：“道衍境。”
暗影幽闻言，目光中闪过一丝惊讶：“你竟然知道道衍境？看来，你确实得到了混沌青莲的传承。但，知道又怎样？你今天，还是要死！”
他抬手，那枚黑色令牌，再次爆发出更加璀璨的黑色光芒。
那道黑色光柱，开始收缩。
那些黑色的光芒，在光柱中心凝聚，缓缓凝聚成一道人影。
那是一个老者。
老者穿着一件黑色的长袍，面容苍老，布满了皱纹。
他的头发花白，散乱地披在肩上。他的眼睛是纯黑色的，没有眼白，仿佛两个黑洞，能吞噬一切光明。
他站在那里，没有任何气息波动。
但整片星空，都在他面前变得安静。
那些星辰停止了闪烁，那些星云停止了流动。

仿佛时间，都在他面前停止了。
他看着林玄，缓缓开口：“是你，杀了本座的徒子徒孙？”
他的声音，很轻很淡，但落在林玄耳中却如同惊雷炸响，蕴含着一股恐怖的力量，直接穿透林玄的防御，轰击他的灵魂。
林玄的身体，微微一晃，但很快稳住，看着那老者，目光平静：“是朕。”
老者看着他，缓缓点了点头：“有点意思。能挡住本座一声轻喝，你，确实有点本事。但，也仅此而已。”
他抬手，伸出一根手指，朝林玄轻轻一点。
没有恐怖的气势，没有惊天动地的异象，就那么轻轻一点，仿佛在点一只蚂蚁。
但林玄的脸色，却猛然变得凝重。
老者那一指，蕴含的力量极其恐怖。
那股力量不是混沌之力，不是混洞之力，而是一种更加高级的力量——一种，可以衍生万物的力量。
那，就是道衍境的力量。
道衍境，无中生有，自衍大道法则。
老者的那一指，看似简单，但其中蕴含了无数种法则，那些法则交织在一起，形成一种恐怖的攻击。
林玄没有硬接。
他身形一闪，消失在原地。下一刻，他出现在老者身后，一拳轰向老者的后心。
content_en:
The black beam of light shot straight into the sky, dyeing the entire starry sky an ink color.
The aura of awakening is getting stronger and stronger.
It was as if a sleeping ancient ferocious beast was crawling out of the abyss.
The twinkling stars in the starry sky were frightened by the aura and dimmed one after another, and even the light became distorted in front of the aura.
Lin Xuan stood on the half-broken star wreckage, looking up at the black beam of light with calm eyes.
He could feel that the aura really transcended the Hundong Realm.
That is the power above the Hundong Realm—the power of the Daoyan Realm.
Shadow You looked at Lin Xuan and let out a ferocious laugh: "Lin Xuan, have you seen it? This is the power of the ancestor of the Shadow Palace! You, a junior who has just broken through the mixed cave realm, are just an ant in front of the ancestor!"
Lin Xuan didn't look at him, his eyes still fell on the black beam of light.
He slowly said: "Daoyan realm."
When Yingying You heard this, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes: "You actually know about the Daoyan realm? It seems that you have indeed obtained the inheritance of Chaos Qinglian. But, so what if you know? You are still going to die today!"
He raised his hand, and the black token once again burst into even brighter black light.
The black beam of light began to shrink.
Those black rays of light condensed in the center of the light pillar, slowly condensing into a figure.
That's an old man.
The old man was wearing a black robe, and his face was old and wrinkled.
His hair was gray and hung loosely on his shoulders. His eyes were pure black, with no whites, like two black holes that could swallow up all light.
He stood there without any breath fluctuation.
But the entire starry sky became silent in front of him.
The stars stopped twinkling, the nebulae stopped flowing.
It was as if time had stopped in front of him.
He looked at Lin Xuan and said slowly: "Are you the one who killed my disciples and grandsons?"
His voice was very light and faint, but it sounded like thunder in Lin Xuan's ears. It contained a terrifying power that directly penetrated Lin Xuan's defense and bombarded his soul.
Lin Xuan's body swayed slightly, but he quickly stabilized and looked at the old man with calm eyes: "It's me."
The old man looked at him and nodded slowly: "It's interesting. If you can block my shout, you are indeed quite capable. But that's all."
He raised his hand, stretched out a finger, and tapped Lin Xuan lightly.
There is no terrifying momentum, no earth-shattering vision, just a light tap, as if tapping an ant.
But Lin Xuan's expression suddenly became solemn.
The power contained in the old man's finger was extremely terrifying.
That power is not the power of chaos, not the power of chaos, but a more advanced power - a power that can derive all things.
That is the power of Daoyan realm.
In the realm of Taoism, something is created out of nothing and the laws of Taoism are derived from oneself.
The old man's finger seemed simple, but it contained countless laws, and those laws were intertwined to form a terrifying attack.
Lin Xuan did not force the answer.
His figure flashed and disappeared. The next moment, he appeared behind the old man and punched the old man in the back.
